origins.label: Paris suburbs
origins.blurb: You grew up one RER ride from everything and two from anything. You can read a delayed-train announcement like poetry.

origins.label: Small-town kid
origins.blurb: One bakery, one roundabout, one bus a day. Everyone back home calls you 'the one who went to the big school'.

origins.label: Central Paris
origins.blurb: Your parents' friends all 'know someone at a bank'. You have never once been lost in the metro, and you will mention it.

origins.label: Regional city
origins.blurb: Lyon, Lille, Nantes or Toulouse: you came up on the TGV with a suitcase of homemade jam and strong opinions about Paris prices.

origins.label: International student
origins.blurb: You crossed borders for this. The canteen is your first culture shock, the bureaucracy your second, the bise your third.

footprint.label: Flights home for the holidays (student years)

origins.label: Third-culture kid
origins.blurb: Four countries, three accents, zero good answers to 'so where are you from?'. You make friends fast and miss them faster.

budgets.label: Tight budget
budgets.blurb: Scholarship, part-time hopes and a spreadsheet for groceries. Pasta is not a meal, it is a lifestyle.

budgets.label: Comfortable
budgets.blurb: Your parents help with rent and you pretend not to need it. The occasional sète is in the budget. Mostly.

budgets.label: Wealthy
budgets.blurb: Your family has a 'house in the countryside' that has a name. You've never checked a price tag before checkout.

traits.label: Maths olympiad kid
traits.blurb: You solved your first integral at fourteen, for fun. Code compiles when you look at it.

traits.label: Born networker
traits.blurb: You remember everyone's name and their dog's. Group projects mysteriously go well when you're in them.

traits.label: Hustler
traits.blurb: You sold sweets in middle school at a 300% margin. You already have a side project and a pitch for it.

traits.label: Creative
traits.blurb: You draw in the margins, film everything and name your playlists like art exhibitions.

traits.label: Athlete
traits.blurb: You run before breakfast and recover after. Your resting heart rate is a flex.

traits.label: Top-of-the-class kid
traits.blurb: A 'mention très bien' bac or a near-perfect IB score: high school taught you to revise at 2AM and feel guilty at 2PM. Your grades are excellent. Your sleep is not.
